q.q: If X + Y means X is the mother of Y, X - Y means X is the brother of Y, and X * Y means X is the father of Y, which of the following means 'M is the nephew of N'?
q.x: In N * O - M, N is the father of O and O is the brother of M. Since O and M are siblings and N is their father, M is the child of N. M is the nephew if M is male, which is implied by the brother relationship.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Ramesh said, 'He is the son of the only son of my mother.' How is Ramesh related to the boy?
q.x: The 'only son of my mother' is Ramesh himself. Therefore, the boy is the son of Ramesh. Thus, Ramesh is the father of the boy.

q.q: Pointing to a woman, a man said, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
q.x: The only daughter of the man's mother is his sister. Since the woman's mother is his sister, the man is the woman's uncle or father, but the 'only' daughter implies the man is the father.

q.q: A is the father of B. C is the daughter of B. D is the brother of B. E is the son of A. What is the relationship between C and E?
q.x: A is the father of B and E, so E is B's brother. Since C is the daughter of B, E is the brother of C's father. Thus, E is the uncle of C, and C is the niece of E.

q.q: A family consists of six members P, Q, R, S, T, and U. P is the mother of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S. T is the brother of S. U is the wife of R. How is T related to P?
q.x: P is the mother of Q, R, and Q. R is the father of T (since T is brother of S). Therefore, T is the grandson of P.

q.q: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.' How is the boy related to the girl?
q.x: The father of the girl's uncle is the girl's grandfather. The daughter of the grandfather is either the girl's mother or aunt. The son of the mother/aunt is the girl's brother or cousin. Given standard phrasing, he is her brother.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph of a man, Rohan said, 'He is the son of the only son of my father.' How is the man in the photograph related to Rohan?
q.x: The father's only son is Rohan himself. Therefore, the man in the photograph is the son of Rohan.

q.q: Pointing to a man in a photograph, a woman says, 'He is the only son of the father of my sister's brother.' How is the man related to the woman?
q.x: The 'sister's brother' is the woman's brother. The 'father of the woman's brother' is the woman's father. The 'only son of the woman's father' is the woman's brother.

q.q: K is the brother of T. M is the mother of K. W is the brother of M. How is W related to T?
q.x: K and T are siblings since M is the mother of K. W is the brother of M, so W is the maternal uncle of both K and T.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's son is my father's son.' Whose photograph is it?
q.x: My father's son is myself (since I have no siblings). So, that man's son is me. Therefore, the man in the photo is my father.

q.q: Introducing a man, a woman said, 'His wife is the only daughter of my father.' How is the woman related to the man?
q.x: The only daughter of the woman's father is the woman herself. Since the man's wife is the woman, the woman is the wife of the man.

q.q: In a family, there are six members A, B, C, D, E, and F. A and B are a married couple. A is the father of C. C is the son of A. D is the granddaughter of E. F is the brother of C. Who is the mother of C?
q.x: A and B are a married couple, and A is the father of C. Therefore, B must be the mother of C. All other relations provided are supplementary to identify the family structure.

q.q: If P + Q means P is the father of Q, and P - Q means P is the sister of Q, how is R related to S in R + T - S?
q.x: R + T means R is the father of T. T - S means T is the sister of S. Therefore, R is the father of both T and S, making R the uncle of no one; he is the father.

q.q: Five members of a family are traveling in a car. A is the father of B. C is the daughter of A. D is the brother of E and E is the son of B. Who is the grandfather of E?
q.x: A is the father of B. E is the son of B. Therefore, A is the father of B, and B is the parent of E, making A the grandfather of E.

q.q: P + Q means P is the father of Q. P - Q means P is the mother of Q. P * Q means P is the sister of Q. If A + B * C - D, how is A related to D?
q.x: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. C is the mother of D. Since A is the grandfather of C's children, A is the maternal grandfather of D.

q.q: Looking at a portrait, Raman said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose portrait was Raman looking at?
q.x: Since Raman has no siblings, 'my father's son' is Raman himself. Thus, the man's father is Raman, meaning the portrait is of his son.

q.q: Looking at a portrait, Suresh said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose portrait was Suresh looking at?
q.x: 'My father's son' with no siblings must be Suresh himself. Therefore, the man's father is Suresh. Thus, the man is Suresh's son.

q.q: In a family, there are six members P, Q, R, S, T, and U. P and R are married. T is the son of R. U is the daughter of T. Q is the granddaughter of P. S is the brother of T. How is Q related to S?
q.x: P and R are a married couple. T is their son. S is also the son of P and R. Since Q is the granddaughter of P and T is the son of P, Q must be the daughter of T or S. Since Q is the granddaughter, and U is the daughter of T, Q is the niece of S.

q.q: P + Q means P is the father of Q; P - Q means P is the mother of Q; P * Q means P is the sister of Q. If A + B * C - D, who is the grandmother of D?
q.x: A + B means A is father of B. B * C means B is sister of C. C - D means C is mother of D. Since B is the sister of C and C is the mother of D, B is the maternal aunt of D, and A is the grandfather. The question asks for grandmother, which is B's mother, but she is not mentioned; however, if we trace the line, B is the maternal figure.

q.q: If A is the brother of B, C is the sister of A, and D is the brother of E, who is the daughter of B, then who is the uncle of D?
q.x: D and E are children of B. Since A is the brother of B, A is the uncle of B's children. Therefore, A is the uncle of D.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph, Amit said, 'This woman is the wife of the only son of my father's mother.' How is the woman related to Amit?
q.x: Amit's father's mother is his grandmother. The only son of his grandmother is his father. The wife of his father is his mother, but the question says 'the wife of the only son', and if Amit is the only son, it is his mother; however, if Amit has siblings, it could be an aunt. Given standard logical phrasing, this refers to his mother, but if the only son is Amit's father, she is his mother.

q.q: In a family, there are two fathers, two mothers, and three children. How many members are there in the family?
q.x: A grandfather, his son (father), his daughter-in-law (mother), and three children (two of whom are siblings) fit this description. The grandfather and the father are the two fathers, while the mother and the grandmother (if present, but not required here) or the daughter-in-law and her mother-in-law satisfy the requirement.

q.q: Pointing to a lady, Mohan said, 'She is the sister of the father of my mother's son.' Who is the lady to Mohan?
q.x: My mother's son is Mohan's brother. The father of Mohan's brother is Mohan's father. The sister of Mohan's father is Mohan's aunt.

q.q: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my father.' How is the woman related to the man?
q.x: The only daughter of the woman's father is the woman herself. Therefore, the man's mother is the woman. Thus, the woman is the man's mother.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph, Rohan said, 'She is the daughter of the only son of my mother.' How is the lady in the photograph related to Rohan?
q.x: The 'only son of my mother' is Rohan himself. Therefore, the lady is the daughter of Rohan. However, in common blood relation puzzles, 'daughter of my mother's only son' refers to Rohan's daughter, but if the phrase implies the speaker is the only son, the lady is his sister. Given standard logic, she is his sister.

q.q: If X @ Y means X is the wife of Y, and X # Y means X is the son of Y, what does A # B @ C mean?
o: A is the son of C
A is the grandson of C
A is the nephew of C
A is the brother of C
q.x: A # B means A is the son of B. B @ C means B is the wife of C. Therefore, A is the son of B and C, making A the grandson of C's parents, but specifically the child of C.

q.q: Rahul told Anand, 'Yesterday I defeated the only brother of the daughter of my grandmother.' Whom did Rahul defeat?
q.x: The daughter of Rahul's grandmother is his aunt. The only brother of his aunt is his father or uncle. Given the phrasing, it refers to his uncle.

q.q: S is the sister of T. T is the brother of U. U is the daughter of V. How is S related to V?
q.x: S, T, and U are all siblings. Since U is the daughter of V, all three must be the children of V. Therefore, S is the daughter of V.

q.q: A is the brother of B. C is the sister of A. D is the brother of E. E is the daughter of B. Who is the uncle of D?
q.x: D and E are children of B. Since A is the brother of B, A is the uncle of D and E. C is the aunt of D and E.

q.q: A is the brother of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. E is the son of D. How is A related to E?
q.x: A and B are siblings. C is their mother. D is the father of C, making D the grandfather of A and B. E is the son of D, meaning E is the brother of C. Since E is the maternal uncle of A, A is the nephew of E.

q.q: A is the brother of B. C is the father of A. D is the sister of E, and E is the daughter of B. Who is the uncle of D?
q.x: B is the parent of D and E. A is the brother of B. Therefore, A is the uncle of B's children, D and E.

q.q: Introducing Reena, Meena said, 'She is the only daughter of my father's only son.' How is Meena related to Reena?
q.x: Meena's father's only son is Meena's brother. The only daughter of Meena's brother is her niece. Therefore, Meena is the aunt of Reena.

q.q: Pointing to a photograph, A says, 'This lady is the mother of the only son of my father's son.' How is the lady in the photograph related to A?
q.x: A's father's son is either A or A's brother. If it is A, the only son of A is A's son, and the lady is A's wife. If it is A's brother, the lady is the sister-in-law, but the phrasing 'only son' usually implies A himself.

q.q: If X @ Y means X is the wife of Y, X # Y means X is the son of Y, and X $ Y means X is the sister of Y, what does A # B @ C $ D imply?
o: A is the nephew of D
A is the son of D
A is the brother of D
A is the grandson of D
q.x: A # B means A is son of B. B @ C means B is wife of C. C $ D means C is sister of D. Thus, A is the son of C, and C is the sister of D. Therefore, A is the nephew of D.

q.q: If P is the brother of Q, R is the sister of P, S is the father of R, and T is the mother of S, how is T related to Q?
q.x: P, Q, and R are siblings. S is their father. T is the mother of S. Since T is the mother of the father, T is the paternal grandmother of Q.

q.q: Deepak is the brother of Ravi. Rekha is the sister of Atul. Ravi is the son of Rekha. How is Deepak related to Rekha?
q.x: Rekha is the mother of Ravi. Deepak is the brother of Ravi. Therefore, Deepak is also the son of Rekha.

q.q: If X is the brother of Y, Y is the sister of Z, and Z is the father of W, how is X related to W?
q.x: X is the brother of Z (since X is brother of Y and Y is sister of Z). As Z is the father of W, X is the paternal uncle of W.

q.q: Looking at a portrait, Sarita said, 'He is my father's only son's wife's daughter.' How is the person in the portrait related to Sarita?
q.x: My father's only son is my brother. My brother's wife is my sister-in-law. Her daughter is my niece.

q.q: In a family, X is the husband of Y. W is the daughter of X. Z is the husband of W. N is the daughter of Z. What is the relation of N to X?
q.x: X and Y are the parents of W. Z is the husband of W. N is the daughter of Z and W, making N the granddaughter of X and Y.

q.q: P is the sister of Q. R is the mother of Q. S is the father of R. T is the mother of S. How is P related to T?
q.x: P is the child of R, R is the child of S, and S is the child of T. P is two generations below T, making her the great-granddaughter of T.

q.q: If P + Q means P is the father of Q, and P - Q means P is the mother of Q, which of the following represents 'M is the grandmother of N'?
q.x: M - R means M is the mother of R. R + N means R is the father of N. Thus, M is the mother of N's father, which makes M the grandmother.

q.q: A is the husband of B. C is the daughter of A. D is the daughter of C. E is the brother of C. How is E related to D?
q.x: A and B are parents of C and E. Since C and E are siblings, and D is the daughter of C, E is the maternal uncle of D. Therefore, E is the uncle of D.

q.q: A is the mother of B. C is the son of A. D is the brother of E. E is the daughter of B. Who is the grandmother of E?
q.x: A is the mother of B, and B is the parent of E. Therefore, A is the grandmother of E.

q.q: If P @ Q means P is the son of Q, P # Q means P is the sister of Q, and P $ Q means P is the father of Q, how is I related to K in I @ J # K?
q.x: I is the son of J. J is the sister of K. Therefore, I is the son of K's sister, making I the nephew of K.

q.q: If A + B means A is the daughter of B, and A * B means A is the son of B, what does P + Q * R mean?
o: P is the sister of Q
P is the granddaughter of R
P is the daughter of R
P is the wife of R
q.x: Q * R means Q is the son of R. P + Q means P is the daughter of Q. Therefore, P is the daughter of the son of R, making P the granddaughter of R.

q.q: In a group of five members, X is the father of Y. Z is the son of X. W is the brother of Y. V is the sister of Z. Who is the mother of W?
q.x: We know X is the father, but there is no information provided about a mother figure in the group. The relationships given only define the paternal lineage. Therefore, the mother of W cannot be determined.

q.q: P is the father of T. T is the daughter of M. M is the daughter of K. How is K related to P?
q.x: We know P is the father of T and M is the mother of T. K is the parent of M, but the gender of K is not specified. Therefore, K could be either the father-in-law or mother-in-law of P.

q.q: X and Y are brothers. R is the father of Y. S is the brother of T and T is the daughter of X. Who is the uncle of S?
q.x: S and T are children of X. Y is the brother of X. Therefore, Y is the uncle of X's children, S and T.

q.q: In a family, there are six members A, B, C, D, E, and F. A and B are a married couple. A is the male. D is the only son of C, who is the brother of A. E is the sister of D. B is the daughter-in-law of F, whose husband has died. How is E related to A?
q.x: C is the brother of A. D and E are children of C. Since A is the uncle of D and E, E is the niece of A.

q.q: Pointing to a man, Neha said, 'He is the only son of my father's sister.' How is the man related to Neha?
q.x: The father's sister is Neha's aunt. The son of an aunt is a cousin.
